overview.text: The OCA places the venerated Quick to Hear image at Dokheiaríou Monastery on Mount Athos. Its account connects the name with the repentance of the monk Neilos and a promise that the Mother of God would hear those who approached her.

blocks.text: The Athonite image is a fresco beside the entrance to the monastery refectory, on its eastern exterior wall. The source distinguishes this original location from the later chapel and from painted copies carried to other Orthodox communities.

blocks.text: According to the monastery narrative published by the OCA, Neilos repeatedly passed the image with a smoking torch in 1664. He disregarded a warning, lost his sight, and remained before the icon asking forgiveness. The account describes his sight returning and the subsequent enclosure of the corridor as a chapel. A copy made on Athos was sent to Archbishop Tikhon and brought to Saint Tikhon’s Monastery in Pennsylvania in May 1906.
